mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, parent_id, level, sort_order, icon, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{parentId}, #{level}, #{sortOrder}, #{icon}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name = #{name}, parent_id = #{parentId}, level = #{level}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, icon = #{icon}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
